optimizermod.name: OptimizerMod
optimizermod.screen.title: OptimizerMod
optimizermod.tab.hud.desc: FPS, frame time, min/max FPS and the active profile shown on screen.
optimizermod.tab.auto.desc: Automatic adjustment of graphics settings when performance stays low for a long time.
optimizermod.tab.placeholder: This section will be available in stage %s.
optimizermod.profile.potato.desc: Minimum graphics for weak devices, maximum FPS.
optimizermod.profile.custom.desc: Your own values from the Graphics tab.
optimizermod.option.view_distance.desc: How many chunks are drawn around you. Lower = more FPS.
Radius where mobs and plants are updated. Lower = faster.
optimizermod.option.particles.desc: Amount of effect particles. Lower = faster.
optimizermod.option.entity_shadows.desc: Round shadows under entities. Off = faster.
optimizermod.option.biome_blend.desc: Colour smoothing at biome borders. Lower = faster.
optimizermod.option.vsync.desc: Syncs frames with the screen. May lower FPS.
